notes: SECIHTI (Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades y Tecnología, Gobierno de México) national convocatoria. It is a one-off complementary childcare payment (MXN 43,876.35) for existing beneficiaries of SECIHTI postgraduate scholarships who had/adopted/recognised a child between 1 Dec 2025 and 30 Nov 2026. It is a government support scheme with no attached host institution, programme or supervising professor; the official page publishes only results lists, guides and a downloadable convocatoria PDF. Verified live at https://secihti.mx/convocatoria/becas-nacionales/convocatoria-2026-apoyo-complementario-de-maternidad-y-paternidad-nacional-en-el-extranjero-y-de-consolidacion.

DOST-SEI Foreign Graduate Scholarships is a Philippine national government scholarship: successful grantees proceed to MS/PhD study at reputable institutions abroad of their own choosing, so no host institution or supervising professor is attached to the award itself. Source access note: the official portal https://fgs.science-scholarships.ph is a JavaScript-only application (server fetch returns only the document title 'Foreign Graduate Scholarships'), and the parent SEI site https://sei.dost.gov.ph is behind a Cloudflare interactive challenge (returns only the page title), so programme text could not be read directly. Outcome is not_applicable regardless, since no institution is attached to the scheme.

Barbara Wood Memorial Foundation Scholarship is a charitable-trust award (up to NZD 1,000 p.a.) administered by the New Zealand Federation of Women's Institutes for South Pacific-born tertiary students in any New Zealand or South Pacific institution. No host institution, department or supervising faculty is attached; awards are decided by the Foundation's trustees. Verified live at https://www.wi.org.nz/Site/scholarships/BW_Memorial_Foundation.aspx (Foundation history, eligibility, value, 2026 recipients list; no faculty/supervisor content).

Türkiye Scholarships - IsDB Joint Scholarship Program is a national government scheme co-funded by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB) and the Islamic Development Bank. Placement is at 'prestigious universities in Türkiye' chosen centrally after selection, so no supervising professor is tied to the award. Verified live at the official announcement page: 'The program aims to enable high-achieving students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities living in other countries to receive education at internationally recognized standards at prestigious universities in Türkiye.'

Errol Walton Barrow Scholarships are a Government of Barbados award administered by the Ministry of Education Transformation. Applicants must 'have been accepted at an accredited institution' of their own choosing (USA, Canada, UK or elsewhere) and the award pays tuition directly to the university plus airfare and a living allowance. No host institution or supervising professor is attached to the award. Verified live at https://education.gov.bb/2026-errol-walton-barrow-scholarships (contact is the Ministry's Tertiary Section, tertiary@mes.gov.bb).

notes: PSI is a one-year MSc in theoretical physics at the Perimeter Institute, delivered with the University of Waterloo (MSc in Physics awarded by Waterloo). The official programme page describes a supervised component: 'Essay - a research project supervised by a faculty member, producing an essay that is publicly presented and defended at the end of the PSI program.' Scholarship is institutional: 'Full scholarships are available to cover: Full tuition, Accommodation, Meals, Living stipend, Health insurance, Necessary IT equipment and learning materials, Travel supplement' (https://perimeterinstitute.ca/training/masters-program/psi-financial-support). Additional PSI teaching faculty listed on the official 'PSI Program - Our People' page but with no published email found: Ghazal Geshnizjani (Cosmology, https://perimeterinstitute.ca/people/ghazal-geshnizjani), Aldo Riello (Mathematical Physics / Quantum Gravity, https://perimeterinstitute.ca/people/aldo-riello), Dan Wohns (Cosmology), Gang Xu (Cosmology). Perimeter profile pages do not publish individual email addresses, so emails above were taken from the University of Waterloo Physics & Astronomy contact pages (uwaterloo.ca institutional domain); they are recorded exactly as published there.

Killam Fellowships Program (Fulbright Canada) is a binational undergraduate exchange fellowship: fellows spend one semester or one academic year at a host university across ~45 partner institutions in Canada and the United States, with no research supervision component and no institution attached to the award. Verified live at https://www.fulbright.ca/programs/killam-fellowships (exchange structure, award amounts, partner university lists, orientation and spring seminar; no faculty/supervisor content). Only general programme contact published: info@fulbright.ca.
